notes: needs_ruling: the report is a narrated encounter in which the Imam answers («قالَ: اِبْنِي عَلِيٌ»); the chain ends at the asked Imam, but the father named in «إِنّي سَأَلْتُ أَباكَ» is the source of «أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ هُوَ» and is not written as a link
«أَبُو عَبْدِاللَّه» after his death is named in the words only: not a link
«حَدَّثَنا أَبي» is the compiler's own father, a bare relation
